## Checklist
- [ ] Membaca `docs/BUG_REGISTRY.md` sebelum perubahan
- [ ] Bug registry diperbarui (jika fix bug)
- [ ] `go vet ./...` lulus
- [ ] `go test ./...` lulus
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` lulus
- [ ] `npm run build` (web-dashboard) lulus
- [ ] `./scripts/check-constraints.sh` lulus
- [ ] Tidak ada secret/credentials di kode
- [ ] Test regresi ditambahkan/diupdate (jika fix bug)
